comparison.objective: Make one irreversible punch mark at a scribed center; candidate commissions a damper through repeated test cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Vertical tip alignment and force buildup versus recessed hex-key use, fine rotational tuning, counterholding, and iterative response correction.
comparison.success_condition: One centered dent followed by tool clearance versus two safe repeatable stops plus locked-setting retention.
comparison.reason: Force-controlled punching and dynamic damper adjustment have different objectives, mechanics, and failure criteria.
